title: On a generalization of Abelian equivalence and complexity of infinite words
notes: J. Combin. Theory Ser. A 120 (2013), 2189-2206. Two words are k-abelian equivalent when they have the same number of overlapping occurrences of every factor of length at most k. For length at least k-1 this is equivalent to equal length-(k-1) prefixes and suffixes together with equal length-k factor counts. The definition used in the kabelian_complexity gate.
